# Design tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-design.py from quickshell/MenuStyle.qml and quickshell/theme/themes.json. Do not edit: change the source, then run `python3 scripts/gen-design.py`. scripts/check.py fails when this file is stale. -->

Every named size, font, motion value and colour. The rules are in `CLAUDE.md` (Theme, Design rules); this is only the numbers. Values are shown as written in MenuStyle.qml, so a name that points at another name shows that name.

## Palettes (`quickshell/theme/themes.json`)

`edge` is the contrast from `base` to `highlight` (the bevel's light edge, at least 1.35), `text / base` the text contrast (at least 4.5).
